info.name: Manage My Shifts API
info.description:
Postman collection for the Manage My Shifts API (Node.js, Express, MongoDB, JWT).

Setup: start the API, then open the Variables tab of this collection and set adminEmail and adminPassword (Current value column) to an administrator account. Run the collection with the Collection Runner (Run collection): requests run in order, each one has tests, and a temporary worker is created and deleted.

Order matters: the folders create the data that later requests use. Folder 5 resets the worker password, which deletes that worker's data, as the specification requires.

exec: pm.test("Payload has id and permission", function () { var u = pm.response.json().user; pm.expect(u.id).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(u.permission).to.eql("regular_user"); });
pm.test("Passwords are not returned", function () { pm.response.json().forEach(function (u) { pm.expect(u).to.not.have.property("password"); }); });

item.name: Get all shifts as admin (owner populated)

exec: pm.test("Owner is populated", function () { var s = pm.response.json()[0]; if (s) { pm.expect(s.userId).to.have.property("firstName"); } });

item.name: User comments array contains the comment

exec: pm.test("Comment id is in user.comments", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().comments).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("commentId")); });
